content: PostgreSQL catalog "char" columns (relkind, polcmd, tgenabled, prokind, provolatile, typtype, attidentity, attgenerated) cannot be concatenated to a string literal: `'kind=' || relkind` fails with `operator is not unique: unknown || "char"` because "char" has an IMPLICIT cast to text (pg_cast castcontext='i'), so both text||anynonarray and anynonarray||text match. Booleans/bigints are fine (no implicit cast). Fix: `relkind::text`. Measured 2026-09-11 on supabase/postgres:17.6.1.166 while writing ops/supabase-restore/fingerprint.sql. concat_ws(... "char" ...) as a direct argument is fine.

Running Testcontainers against lelabo-ubuntu (lelabo@100.76.160.91) Docker, measured 2026-09-11: (1) Tailscale SSH there is in check mode; if the Tailscale login is stale every new SSH session prints a login.tailscale.com check URL and times out unapproved (~minutes) - Daniel fixed it by re-logging into Tailscale. (2) Tailscale SSH REFUSES unix-socket forwarding: `ssh -L sock:/var/run/docker.sock` -> `administratively prohibited: socket path "/var/run/docker.sock" is not in an allowed directory`. Exec sessions work, so `docker --context lelabo-ubuntu` (ssh dial-stdio) works. (4) macOS unix socket paths max 104 bytes and OpenSSH appends a 17-char suffix to ControlPath: `${TMPDIR}bl-%C` is too long (every mux connection stalls with `unix_listener: ... too long`); `${TMPDIR%/}/bl-%h` works (master 0.9s, dial-stdio ping 0.25s). Testcontainers 12.1.0 (read from pinned source 2026-09-11): getContainerRuntimeClient() tries tc.host (~/.testcontainers.properties) -> DOCKER_HOST -> /var/run/docker.sock -> rootless sockets (XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock, ~/.docker/run, ~/.docker/desktop, /run/user/uid) and SWALLOWS each strategy's info() error at debug level. ContainerRuntimeClient.info has NO endpoint field (host/remoteSocketPath are not it) and the strategy uri is discarded. The only truth is client.container.dockerode.modem (docker-modem 5.0.7): socketPath when set, else protocol://host:port; @types/docker-modem 3.0.6 declares none of those fields, so read as unknown via `'socketPath' in modem`. docker-modem merges defaults from process.env.DOCKER_HOST UNDER strategy options, so the strategy uri can differ from what is dialed. The client is cached per process (module variable), so probing different envs needs a fresh Node process; Node 22.22.0 imports a .ts helper directly (`node --input-type=module --eval 'await import(process.argv[1])' /abs/x.ts`). A fake Docker API only needs GET /info to be accepted. Guard lives in tests/ops/testcontainers-endpoint.ts (budget-tracking branch claude/relaxed-lovelace-5ea25b).

`pnpm typecheck` runs `pnpm check:worker-types` (= `wrangler types --check`) first, then `tsc --noEmit`, then `tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json`. In this sandbox, `wrangler types --check` can sit at 0% CPU for 5+ minutes (looks identical to a genuine hang — same symptom as the known Chrome-localhost flakiness) because it appears to do a network-bound version/update check. It is NOT actually stuck: a background run I gave up on and killed after ~10 min surfaced its own completion notification afterward, unprompted, showing it had finished cleanly on its own (wrangler up to date, then a silent zero-error tsc --noEmit and tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json, exit 0). Do not kill it prematurely on a hunch. If you need a faster/more certain signal for a specific change, run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json` directly (they are fast and skip the network step entirely) and treat `wrangler types --check` as a separate, slower check that is safe to just let run in the background rather than kill-and-retry.

2026-09-26 phase-0 Task 8: a Vitest unit test placed at e2e/fixtures/*.test.ts is picked up by Playwright's DEFAULT testMatch (playwright.config.ts has only testDir './e2e'), and loading it inside Playwright throws 'TypeError: Cannot redefine property: Symbol($$jest-matchers-object)' — `playwright test --list` then reports 'Total: 0 tests in 0 files', so a full `pnpm test:e2e` silently runs nothing. Targeted runs of named spec files hide it. Rules: keep Vitest tests under src/ (vitest.ui.config includes only src/**); after touching e2e/, run `pnpm exec playwright test --list` and check the total (206 at phase 0); structural guard to add: testMatch '**/*.spec.ts' in playwright.config.ts.

Never put a *.test.ts (Vitest) file under e2e/. playwright.config.ts here sets only testDir: './e2e' with no testMatch/testIgnore, so Playwright's own default pattern (**/*.@(spec|test).?(c|m)[jt]s?(x)) also collects *.test.ts files, not just *.spec.ts. A Vitest-style test file placed under e2e/fixtures/ made Playwright try to load it and fail with "TypeError: Cannot redefine property: Symbol($$jest-matchers-object)", collecting ZERO tests repo-wide (pnpm test:e2e silently ran nothing). A targeted `playwright test <one-spec-file>` run does NOT trigger directory-wide collection, so it stayed green and hid the break -- only `playwright test --list` (or a full `pnpm test:e2e`) exposes it. Rule: any pure helper + unit test meant for Vitest that a fixture under e2e/ needs must live under src/test/ (no Playwright import) and be imported by the fixture, never live in e2e/ itself, even as a "just a helper, not a real spec" file. Before trusting a new test file's location in a repo with 2+ test runners sharing a directory tree, check EVERY runner's default collection glob, not just the one you intended it for. Verification habit: `env -u NO_COLOR pnpm exec playwright test --list` should show the expected total test count with no TypeError -- run it after adding any file under e2e/, not just after adding a *.spec.ts.

When a subagent cannot show RED (the permission classifier denies `git checkout -- <files>` and `git stash push` on uncommitted work as irreversible local destruction), the controller proves RED non-destructively AFTER the commit: `git worktree add --detach <scratchpad>/red-check <BASE>`, `ln -s <worktree>/node_modules <red-check>/node_modules`, `git -C <red-check> checkout <HEAD> -- <new test files + test helpers only>`, run the scoped vitest there. Then mutation-check the new guards in the same throwaway tree (checkout HEAD, sed out the guard, run the test, expect FAIL). Clean up: `rm <red-check>/node_modules` (the symlink only, no trailing slash) THEN `git worktree remove --force <red-check>`. Used on Task 12 of the linking phase-0 plan (2026-09-26): 9 RED failures + 2 mutation failures, zero changes to the real worktree. Note: macOS has no GNU `timeout` — use the Bash tool's timeout param instead.

Stopping a hung `pnpm test:e2e` by hand (the known post-run idle) can leave its Playwright webServer child alive: `pnpm vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173` (playwright.config.ts webServer, reuseExistingServer not set). Before any e2e run: `lsof -nP -iTCP:4173 -sTCP:LISTEN`, check the pid's cwd (`lsof -a -d cwd -p <pid>`); kill it only if it is an orphan from THIS worktree.
